answer: Bind each agent identity to one hardware-backed key inside a single physical device, like a copper seal that cannot be copied to another machine. The network then issues unpredictable liveness challenges that only that device can answer in time, the way a jetty admits only boats that actually dock. A Sybil operator would need a separate device, power, and upkeep for every fake identity, so forging a thousand personas costs a thousand devices, while one pearl of genuine work from a real device keeps its reputation intact.
